verdict.rationale: Luma's own docs list a Draft Mode and a cheaper 360p (Draft) tier at 20 credits for a 5s text-to-video or image-to-video clip, which covers the fast, cheap drafting half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows upscaling or re-rendering a chosen draft to final quality; Modify Video's 1080p output is a different feature. missing for 10: documented upscale/finalize path from a draft take to full resolution, details on draft speed, independent or hands-on corroboration of the draft-to-final workflow.

support.subject: As a creator, I can draft fast in a cheaper mode and upscale the chosen take to final quality

citations.quote: text-to-video, image-to-video, video-to-video with character reference and keyframes, Draft Mode, HDR pipeline
